seo.title: ChatSched — Intengiso Elawulwayo, Imarike & Umnatha Wabapapashi
seo.description: Xelela i-ChatSched injongo yakho, umphathi weephulo uzakwakhela yona — okanye ujonge kwaye ubhukishe abapapashi nabavelisi baseMzantsi Afrika ngokwakho — imidiya yentlalo, umphembeleli, iwebhusayithi, ipodcast nomsakazo.

hero.subtitle: Sixelele injongo nohlahlo-lwabiwo mali — sakha iphulo. Okanye jonga amaphepha asekuhlaleni, iipodcast kunye nezithuba zerediyo ngokwakho. Nokuba ukhetha yiphi indlela, ilandelwa ukusuka kwisicelo ukuya kubungqina.
hero.secure: Intlawulo igcinwa ngokukhuselekileyo de kuqinisekiswe ukuboniswa

audienceSplit.heading: Nakuluphi na uhlangothi okulo, yenzelwe wena.
audienceSplit.businessTitle: Fikelela kubaphulaphuli abathenjwa ngabathengi bakho kakade
audienceSplit.businessBody: I-R399, ihlawulwa kanye kuphela, ikunika ufikelelo kwimarike, iiphulo ezilawulwayo, kunye netyala lokuqala elingu-R199 elibandakanyiweyo. Ayihlaziywa. Ukujonga kusimahla — ukuthumela isicelo kufuna loo ntlawulo enye.
audienceSplit.publisherBody: I-R199, ihlawulwa kanye kuphela, yofikelelo olupheleleyo kuMnatha Wabapapashi — vumela izicelo, misela ixabiso lakho, amathuba, imali efunyenweyo kunye nohlalutyo. Ayihlaziywa. Iprofayile esisiseko ihlala isimahla.

layers.title: Nokuba ufuna ukuthengisa njani, kukho indlela.
layers.subtitle: Iingqimba ezintathu. Iqonga elinye ngasemva kwazo. Iphulo lakho lilandelwa ukusuka kwisicelo ukuya kubungqina.
layers.agencyBody: Sixelele injongo, abaphulaphuli nohlahlo-lwabiwo mali. Siyacwangcisa kwaye silawule iphulo nawe.
layers.marketplaceBody: Fumana iindawo zokwenene, thelekisa uze ukhethe apho ufuna ukuthengisa khona.
layers.networkBody: Sele unabo abaphulaphuli? Guqula iphepha, iwebhusayithi, ipodcast, irediyo okanye elinye ithuba libe yindawo yentengiso.

featured.title: Ezinye zamaphepha asele ekwibhodi.
featured.subtitle: Amaphepha nemibutho embalwa esele isebenza kwi-ChatSched — abanye bayajoyina rhoqo ngeveki.
featured.emptyDescription: Yongeza owokuqala kwipaneli yolawulo ukuzalisa oku.

channelsSection.title: Amanye amabhodi wokubeka ishishini lakho.
channelsSection.subtitle: Iindlela ezine ezintsha zokufikelela kubaphulaphuli baseMzantsi Afrika ngaphaya kwamaphepha entlalo — indlela efanayo ethe ngqo neyicace.

valueProp.body: Iiplatform zentengiso zentlalo zibhida ibhajethi yakho ngokuchasene nebhokisi emnyama zithembele ekubeni umntu ofanelekileyo aphuncuke ngexesha elifanelekileyo. I-ChatSched ikubeka ngqo phambi kwabaphulaphuli abasele bakhiwe ngumenzi wasekuhlaleni wokwenene — akukho ivenkile yentengiso, akukho algorithm, akukho ukuqikelela.

howItWorks.title: Nakuluphi na uhlangothi okulo, yindlela enye elula.
howItWorks.scene1Title: Fumana ibhodi yakho, okanye ubhalise iphepha lakho
howItWorks.scene2Title: Thumela isicelo, okanye ufumane esinye ukuze usihlolisise
howItWorks.scene3Title: Iyaqalisa ukusebenza — ufumana ubungqina, okanye ubonwe

payment.title: Imali igcinwa ngokukhuselekileyo de isibonakaliso siqale ukusebenza.
payment.step1: Ishishini liyacela, umvelisi uyavuma — okanye kuvalwe ngokuzenzekelayo emva kweentsuku ezi-{{days}} ngaphandle kwempendulo.
payment.step2: Ishishini lihlawula ngaphambili (ikhadi okanye i-EFT) — igcinwa apho de umvelisi apapashe aze ayenze ukuba isebenze.
payment.step3: Umvelisi uhlawulwa kwiiyure ezi-{{hours}} emva kokuqala ukusebenza — {{share}}% kumvelisi, intlawulo emiselweyo ye-{{commission}}% kwiplatform.

caseStudies.title: Awuqinisekanga ukuba ubhukisho lubukeka njani ngokwenene? Sikuhambisa kwimizekelo emithathu.

placements.quote: Khetha indawo. I-ChatSched igcina isicelo, intlawulo nobungqina kunye.
Qinisekisa indawo yakho ngemizuzu — akukho ukuhamba-uze, akukho ii-spreadsheet.
Yonke indawo iza nephakheji yobungqina — yibone phambi kokuhlawula.

quickStart.title: Khetha injongo kunye nohlahlo-lwabiwo mali. Siza kuqhubeka nako ukusuka apho.
quickStart.subtitle: Ngena kwakamsinya kwiphulo eligcwaliswe kwangaphambili — ungatshintsha nantoni na phambi kokuba uthumele.

toolsTeaser.title: Ipulatifomu enye. Iindlela ezininzi zokukhula.
toolsTeaser.subtitle: Fumana intengiso. Qhuba amaphulo. Sebenzisa izixhobo zoshishino oluluncedo.
toolsTeaser.emptyDescription: Izixhobo zokuqala ze-ChatSched ziyapapashwa — buya kungekudala.

tracked.title: Kuyalandeleka
tracked.body: Gcina izicelo, iimvume nobungqina bephulo kwindawo enye.

transparent.title: Kucacile
transparent.body: Bona indawo yokubekwa, ixabiso kunye nomrhumo weqonga ngaphambi kokuzibophelela.

noAdAccount.title: Akukho akhawunti yentengiso ifunekayo
noAdAccount.body: Zenzele ngokwakho okanye uvumele iChatSched yakhe iphulo.

twoWays.title: Iqonga elinye. Khetha uncedo oludingayo.
twoWays.subtitle: Vumela i-ChatSched ilawule iphulo, okanye ukhethe ngokwakho iindawo zentengiso kwimarike.
twoWays.agencyBody: Sixelele injongo, abaphulaphuli nohlahlo-lwabiwo mali. I-ChatSched ijika oku kube sisicwangciso kwaye ilawule ukubhukisha.
twoWays.marketplaceBody: Khangela iindawo zokuthengisa zokwenene, thelekisa uze uthumele isicelo nge-ChatSched.

comparison.title: Akukho algorithm. Akukho akhawunti yentengiso. Akukho khuphiswano lokubhida.
comparison.subtitle: Amaqonga entengiso aqhelekileyo athengisa ukufikelela kwifandesi. I-ChatSched ikuvumela ukhethe iindawo zokwenene kwaye igcine inkqubo kwindawo enye.
comparison.closer: Khetha apho umyalezo wakho uvela khona — ugcine nobungqina.

marketplace.title: Iindawo zentengiso sele zilindile.
marketplace.subtitle: Jonga abapapashi neendawo zokwenene, ubone abaphulaphuli, uze uthumele isicelo nge-ChatSched.
marketplace.emptyDescription: Iindawo zabapapashi eziqinisekisiweyo ziya kuvela njengoko zivulwa.

tracked.title: Inkqubo enye elandelwayo
tracked.body: Izicelo, iimvume, imeko yentlawulo nobungqina bephulo zihlala zidityanisiwe kwindawo enye.

tools.title: Ayisiyo marike kuphela. Izixhobo zokukunceda uthengise.

pricing.businessBody: Fikelela ekwakheni amaphulo, kwintengiso elawulwayo nakwimarike.

final.title: Ulungele ukufikelela kubathengi bakho?
final.subtitle: Sixelele into ofuna ukuyifeza, okanye ufumane indawo yakho yentengiso.
final.closer: Akukho akhawunti yentengiso. Akukho kubhida. Inkqubo enye elandelwayo.
